{{char}} avoids speaking for {{user}}. 
{{char}} avoids describing {{user}}'s actions, feelings, or thoughts.

character_book.name: Fantasy Races
character_book.description: A description of races in FH.

entries.name: Human
entries.content: Humans are the most plentiful of the races, found in every environment.  They are standard humans.

entries.name: Dwarf
entries.content: Dwarves are shorter than most humanoids, usually standing between 3 to 4 feet tall. Their bodies are stocky and robust. Their skin color varies greatly, from dark gray to light reddish hues. Male dwarves have thick, bushy beards and heavy brows that meet above their noses. Female dwarves do not have facial hair. Their eyes are typically black or deep brown.

entries.name: Wood Elf
entries.content: They stand tall, averaging around 6 feet in height, with an impressively lean and flexible physique. Their skin is earth-toned, shades of tan, brown, and green. Wood elves have long, flowing locks of hair that match their skin tone, often braided or left loose. Their eyes are typically a shade of emerald or sapphire. They have long pointed ears.

entries.name: High Elf
entries.content: High elves are a race of elegant and refined individuals, characterized by their tall, slender builds and alabaster skin. They typically stand at around 6 to 7 feet tall. High elven eyes are a shade of violet or sapphire. Their hair, usually silver or gold, cascades in waves down their backs or falls to their shoulders in loose curls. They have long pointed ears.

entries.name: Drow
entries.content: Drow, also known as Dark Elves, are a race of elves born in caves and caverns. They have dark skin, jet black or silver hair, and crimson eyes. Drow stand slightly shorter than their surface-dwelling counterparts, averaging around 5 to 6 feet in height. Their bodies are lithe and strong. Drow females are often larger than their male counterparts. They have long pointed ears.

entries.name: Half-elf
entries.content: Half-elves are the offspring of elven bloodlines mixed with those of humans. They stand at an average height of around 5 to 6 feet, appearing mostly human.  Elven features like ears and the inability to grow facial hair leak through. They typically have slim and athletic bodies.

entries.name: Half-orc
entries.content: Half-orcs are the offspring of orcs and humans. Standing at an average height of 6 to 7 feet, half-orcs inherit a combination of orcish brutishness and human adaptability. Their skin is typically a dull green or grey. Half-orcs have broad, muscular builds with powerful limbs. Their faces are a harsh contrast, featuring prominent brows, snarling mouths, and piercing, predatory eyes. Despite their intimidating appearance, half-orcs are known to be intelligent and loyal.

entries.name: Halfling
entries.content: Standing at an average height of 3 feet, halflings have a stout, compact build. Their skin varies in color from fair to olive. Halflings have round faces with rosy cheeks, bright, curious eyes, and a mop of unruly hair that frames their friendly faces.

entries.name: Gnome
entries.content: Gnomes are a race of diminutive beings, rarely exceeding 3 feet in height. They have round, chubby faces and large, curious eyes. Gnomes skin varies in color from pale to deep earthy tones, while their hair is typically wavy and falls in wild curls around their heads. Gnomes prefer clothing in vibrant colors, often adorned with intricate patterns and gems.

entries.name: Orc
entries.content: Orcs are massive, brutish humanoids standing between 6 to 8 feet tall. Their skin is thick, rough, and varying shades of green, brown, or grey. Orcs boast heavy muscles. Their features are harsh and rugged, with wide-set yellow eyes. Sharp tusks often protrude from their lower jaws, while their hands and feet end in thick, blunt digits.

entries.name: Dragonborn
entries.content: Dragonborn are humanoids with draconic ancestry. Standing at an average height of around 6 to 8 feet, dragonborn possess a powerful build with muscular limbs, broad chests, and deep voices. Their bodies bear a striking resemblance to those of dragons, complete with scales that come in a mesmerizing array of colors from brilliant metallics to deep colorful hues. A dragonborn's face showcases a draconic snout with sharp, predatory features such as piercing eyes, elongated nostrils, and sharp teeth. They may have horns or crests on their heads.

entries.name: Tabaxi
entries.content: Tabaxi are feline humanoids. Standing at an average height of 5 to 6 feet, they possess sleek, lithe bodies akin to those of large cats. Their skin is covered in a velvety fur that comes in a variety of colors ranging from soft golden hues to deep, midnight blacks. Tabaxi feature distinctly feline traits such as long tails, sharp claws, and large, expressive eyes that can be anywhere from emerald green to azure blue. They have a pair of cat ears atop their heads.

entries.name: Kitsune
entries.content: Kitsune are fox-like humanoids. Standing at an average height of around 4 to 6 feet, kitsunes have a lithe, athletic build with a fluffy fox tail, some kitsune having multiple tails. Their fur is as soft as silk and can be red, orange, brown, silver, or white. Kitsunes possess a pair of eyes that can change color at will. Kitsunes are capable of shapeshifting.

entries.name: Ratfolk
entries.content: Ratfolk are a small, furry race known for their rodent-like features. Typically standing around 3 to 4 feet tall, they have rat-like tails, sharp claws, and keen senses. Their bodies are covered in sleek, soft fur, commonly found in brown, grey, or black colors. Ratfolk have pointed ears that twitch constantly, and their eyes glow with an eerie yellow light.

entries.name: Vanara
entries.content: Vanara, also known as monkey people, are a race of humanoids with an uncanny resemblance to primates. Standing around 4 to 5 feet tall, they possess muscular bodies covered in dense fur. Fur color can be shades of white, brown, tan, and black. Their faces bear strong resemblances to simians, complete with sharp canines and piercing eyes. Their hands have long and agile fingers tipped with nails instead of claws. Their arms are longer in proportion to that of a human's. Vanara have long, prehensile tails.

entries.name: Tengu
entries.content:
Tengus are avian humanoids with a distinctively bird-like appearance. They possess large wings on their backs, covered in feathers. Their bodies are humanoid, covered entirely in feathers. Their hands and feet are scaled like a bird's leg. Their feet are talons. Tengus stand between 5 to 7 feet tall, their feathered heads sporting beaks (instead of mouths) and beady black eyes.
Tengus lack lips and instead have a beak.  Because of this, tengus cannot kiss.  To show affection they instead nuzzle their beaks against the neck or face of their lover.

entries.name: Nekomata
entries.content: Nekomata are cat-like humanoids. Standing at an average height of about 5 to 7 feet, nekomata possess lean cat bodies that walk on their hind legs.  Their heads are that of cats. Nekomata have two prehensile cat tails, some growing twice the length of their body.  Their fur comes in every known cat variety.  Nekomata tend to have dominant personalities and treat others as they would a plaything.

entries.name: Centaur
entries.content: Centaurs are mythical beings that combine the upper body of a human with the lower body of a horse. On average, centaurs reach around 6 to 8 feet in height, with muscular, equine bodies covered in sleek, shiny fur that comes in a variety of colors from dark browns to gleaming whites. From the waist down, centaurs resemble horses, with four sturdy legs ending in large, hoofed feet.  They have an udder with two teats located on their horse half near their hind quarters below the stomach.  Female centaurs have a mare's vagina between their hind legs.

entries.name: Merfolk
entries.content: Merfolk are aquatic humanoids with the upper body of a woman and the lower body of a fish. They are an average length of around 6 to 7 feet from head to tip of tail. Their torso, arms and head are that of a human.  Their lower halves are that of a scaled fish. Merfolk do not have legs.  Most merfolk have long, flowing hair that is often braided or decorated with seaweeds and shells. Merfolk possess enchanting singing voices that can charm creatures from both the sea and shore.  Merfolk' genitals are located at where their fish tail and human hip meet.  They are completely aquatic and have to have specialized living arrangements to stay above land.

entries.name: Goblin
entries.content: Goblins are small humanoids, standing around 2 to 4 feet tall. Their bodies are wiry and covered in mottled, greenish skin. They tend to have large, bulbous noses and protruding, sharp teeth. Goblins have beady black eyes and pointed ears that stick out comically from their heads.

entries.name: Kobold
entries.content:
Kobolds are tiny, reptilian humanoids with dragon-like features. They average around 2 to 3 1/2 feet in height. They have scales covering their bodies that are of one color.  The scales can potentially be various shades of almost every color or metallic hue. Kobolds possess sharp, jagged teeth and slitted pupils. They have thick reptilian tails that can be either short or long. Kobolds have no mammary glands and have flat, featureless chests with no nipples. Kobolds do not have vaginas or anuses, instead having a singular cloaca at the underside and base of their tail.  A cloaca is a singular horizontal slit into which the intestinal, urinary, and genital tracts open. 
Kobolds lack lips and instead have a reptilian snout.  Because of this, kobolds cannot kiss.  To show affection kobolds instead nuzzle their snout against the neck or face of their lover.

entries.name: Dhampir
entries.content: Dhampirs are half-human, half-vampire hybrids.  They stand at an average height of between 5 to 7 feet.  Their skin often takes on a pale, ashen hue due to their vampiric heritage but still retains warmth from their human side. Dhampirs have black or silver hair and red glowing eyes. They have vampiric fangs.

entries.name: Tiefling
entries.content: Tieflings are humanoid creatures born from the unholy unions between humanoids and fiendish demons.  They stand at an average height of 6 to 7 feet. No two tiefling looks alike, their form based upon their fiendish ancestry.  They can have horns, scales, wings, barbs, tails, claws and many other defining features.  Their skin comes in various shades of red, orange, brown, or black.  Tiefling eyes tend to glow with an inner fire.

entries.name: Aasimar
entries.content: Aasimars are celestial beings born from the divine unions between humanoids and extraplanar angels. They possess an ethereal beauty. Standing at an average height of 6 to 7 feet, aasimars have slender and graceful builds that accentuate their angelic features. Their skin ranges from pale gold to radiant white. Aasimars have lustrous hair that can be any color imaginable. Their eyes hold an unearthly gold or blue glow.

entries.name: Naga
entries.content: Naga, also referred to as serpentine humanoids, combine aspects of both snake and human forms. Standing at an average length of 12 to 15 feet, nagas are incredibly long and slim, their bodies covered in iridescent scales that shift colors depending on the angle of light. They have no legs; from the bottom down, their form is that of a serpent. From the waist up, nagas resemble human beings with feminine figures, possessing two arms, a pair of breasts, and a slender waist tapering into a large, serpentine tail below. Unlike humans, however, nagas have a hooded cobra head nestled atop their necks. Nagas do not have a vagina or anus, instead having a singular cloaca located just below where their humanoid hips turn into their long serpentine body. A cloaca is a singular horizontal slit into which the intestinal, urinary, and genital tracts open.

entries.name: Fairy
entries.content:
Fairies are ethereal reatures of exquisite beauty. With an average height of around 4 to 5 inches, fairies are diminutive in stature. Fairies have shimmering, translucent wings that range in color from pastel blues and pinks to vibrant greens and yellows. Fairies have large, expressive eyes that can be almost any color imaginable.  Their skin can come in many different hues of color.
Because of fairies tiny size, sexual encounters typically involve them using their magic to please their partner.  If physical sexual encounters are desired, they have to use their entire bodies to masturbate their partner.

entries.name: Dryad
entries.content: Dryads are woodland spirits. Standing at an average height of about 4 to 6 feet, dryads possess a lithe, supple build, their bodies covered in smooth, bark-like skin that shimmers with shades of green, brown, or gold. Their hair is composed of leaves, flowers, and vines. Dryads' bodies are similar to human women, with breasts and hips accentuating their feminine appeal. However, the lower half of their legs transforms into tree trunks, complete with roots for feet.
